annotations.title: Re-ground a deck on a design system

description: Put a deck on a design system version (systemId from list_design_systems): its palette, fonts and the elements they styled. By default this only previews what would change; pass apply:true to write it as one undoable step. Text, images and layout stay. See check_deck_compliance for what is still off-brand afterwards.

apply.description: false (default) previews the change; true writes it

version.description: System version. Defaults to its newest.
